## par-p08-v08 — argument map

Five deprivations: little-doership (kalā), little-knowing (vidyā), clinging (rāga, may-I-grow-never-cease), sequence-cutting (kāla, was-am-will), must (niyati, mine-to-do). One sheath: fivefold, veiling own-form, distinct-yet-undistinct over full consciousness. Prakṛti: guṇa equipoise past telling apart; root-cause of great-to-earth. Inner organ: deciding intellect, prideing ego, resolving mind — guṇa-effect, sense-gross-cause. Ten senses in order; five commons (that-nothing-more); five element-offices.

### Open
- Five-as-one-sheath kept as stated.
- tanmātra negative definition (tadeva nādhikam); no positive content added.
